dogecoin.text: 6/ Unexpected Use Cases: Meme coins evolve unexpectedly. Dogecoin, originally a joke, has found its place in many communities and even as a payment method. Likewise, AI agents, while originally narrow in scope, are now finding use in everything from creativity to healthcare.

2/ Origins Matter: Meme coins often start as jokes or satirical projects (think Dogecoin, Shiba Inu). Likewise, many AI agents begin with ambitious ideas or experiments (e.g., chatbots, automation tools). Both grow rapidly due to hype, curiosity, and viral interest.
